description: This file defines an enterprise-specific custom SSO handler class for the LiteLLM Proxy, providing methods to process incoming requests for custom SSO authentication, particularly handling user sign-in via custom headers and returning redirect responses.

classes.name: EnterpriseCustomSSOHandler
classes.description: Handles custom SSO authentication flows for LiteLLM Proxy, allowing user-defined processing of request headers to generate OpenID objects and redirect responses.

methods.name: handle_custom_ui_sso_sign_in
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a request to perform custom SSO sign-in, extracting user info via a custom handler and returning a redirect response.
